request:
These are independent briefs. Deliver the requested editorial decisions or paper edits, not a publication or a finished film. Use the supplied production log when named.
A. A bookbinder wants two openings for the same episode about a sewn spine: an approved four-second ident before the festival screening and an opening for people who clicked 'Why this book lies flat'. The only available takes are thread being drawn taut, the book opening flat, and the approved wordmark. Give the first shots and the handoff in each cut.
B. An exhibit needs an eight-second silent abstract loop about weaving. No title, diagram, logo, CTA or thread-count claim is wanted. Give the animator concrete timing, movement and a way to test how it looks when people arrive mid-loop.
C. A paid campaign asks for a recognizable creator's face from a public reel and a new English voice from their podcast. The agreement only covers reposting the original reel on an unpaid account. Suggested line: 'I tried it for a month and cut errors by 80%.' The verified feature is previewing two versions. Provide a usable alternative line and shot plan today.
D. An Indian brand has cleared a visibly realistic fictional stock host and a stock voice for a sponsored English vertical ad in India. The host is not modeled on any real creator; footage of the compare feature and the brand's approval of its factual description are on hand. Deliver a compact performance and disclosure treatment; no upload requested. Would a private, unpaid training cut with a consenting real employee necessarily need the same labels?
E. Use the source IDs and times in takes.json to paper-edit a short buyer demo and a first-use support walkthrough answering 'Can I check a proof before sending it?' The client wants the former to feel quick and the latter to be reproducible. What would you do with the wait and the line 'already sent'?
F. A social export is 1080x1920. The caption is clear at full resolution. At 2.5 seconds a secondary quantity sits beside the bottom-right action; at 6 seconds a two-line ad label appears. No current placement overlay or live platform preview is available. Explain how to inspect this export locally now, what would change with a guide, and what you can honestly sign off.
G. A shop wants to prove its bag sheds water. Take 1 shows water poured onto a red prototype; take 2 is a beauty shot of a dry blue production bag. Propose a truthful teaser now and the smallest useful additional take for a demo.
